title: Rule to owner table in architecture notes
item: Rule → owner table in architecture notes: one row per rule ID (G-xx, CR-xx) naming its owning location, product side (prompt section, tool wrapper, harness code, harness check) and test side (fake system, simulated user, grader, pytest-bdd steps)
motivation: So an agent or a new engineer can find the code to change when a rule changes; more than one product-side owner is a leakage finding (Ousterhout ch. 5; Fundamentals of Software Architecture ch. 8)
notes: Do first: ~13 rows for the café agent, hand-written. Then run the CR-04 (3 → 4 times) change and compare files touched against the table.
done_means: Architecture notes hold one row per rule ID, with one product-side and one test-side owner. One rule change is made on a scratch branch and the files touched are compared with the table.
